paite: Tuikulh a gamte aw, ka thu ngaikhala, gamlapi a michih aw, ngaikhia un; TOUPA'N sul a kipan ahon sap ka hi; ka nu gilsung a pan in ka min agenta hi.
heading: Israel, Namte Vakna
english: Listen, islands, to me; and listen, you peoples, from far: Yahweh has called me from the womb; from the bowels of my mother has he made mention of my name:

paite: Ka kam namsau hiam bang in abawl a, akhut ah ahon sel a; thal nawttet vilvel in hon bawl a, athalbawm ah ahon khum a;
english: and he has made my mouth like a sharp sword; in the shadow of his hand, he has hidden me: and he has made me a polished shaft; in his quiver has he kept me close:

paite: Ka kiang ah, "Nang zaw ka sikha na hi; Israel pahtawi a ka omna ding na hi,” achi a.
english: and he said to me, “You are my servant; Israel, in whom I will be glorified.”

paite: Ke'n bel, "Athawn in ka semgim a, bangmah lou ding leh huihkhua lel ding in ka thapai; himahleh pel lou in ka tung a vaihawmna ding TOUPA kiang ah ahi a-om, hon ditna ding leng ka Pathian kiang ah ahi a-om," ka chi a.
english: But I said, “I have labored in vain, I have spent my strength for nothing and vanity; yet surely the justice due to me is with Yahweh, and my reward with my God.”

paite: Huan tu in TOUPA, Jakobte akiang a pi nawnna ding leh Israelte akiang pikhawm a a-omna ding un, asikha a om ding a sul a kipan a hon bawlpa'n agen, TOUPA mitmuh in mizahtakhuai ka hi ngal a, ka Pathian ka hatna ahi behlap hi.
english: Now says Yahweh who formed me from the womb to be his servant, to bring Jacob again to him, and that Israel be gathered to him (for I am honorable in the eyes of Yahweh, and my God has become my strength);

paite: Ahi, ama'n, "Jakob namte tundinna ding leh Israelte lak a humbitte a-omsak nawnna ding in, ka sikha a na om zaw, thil neuchik mahmah ahi lai; Zentelte vaksakpa ding in ka hon sep ding, kawlmong pha a hondampa dia na omtheihna ding in," achi a.
english: yes, he says, “It is too light a thing that you should be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Israel: I will also give you for a light to the nations, that you may be my salvation to the end of the earth.”

paite: TOUPA, Israelte tanpa leh a Mi Siangthou un, mite muhsitpa, namte kih tuntun, vaihawmte sikha kiang ah hichi in achi: "Muanhuai TOUPA, Israelte Mi Siangthou, nang hon telpa ziak in Kumpipate'n amu ding ua, athou ding uh; miliante'n amah abe ding uh," chi in.
english: Thus says Yahweh, the Redeemer of Israel, and his Holy One, to him whom man despises, to him whom the nation abhors, to a servant of rulers: “Kings shall see and arise; princes, and they shall worship; because of Yahweh who is faithful, even the Holy One of Israel, who has chosen you.”

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Hun kipahhuai ah ka hon dawng a, hotdamna ni ah ka hon panpih hi; ka hon hawi ding a, mipite thukhunna ding in ka hon pe ding, lei dingkipsak a, gouluah nutsiatsa luahsak ding in;
heading: Jerusalem Tunding Nawnna
english: Thus says Yahweh, “In an acceptable time have I answered you, and in a day of salvation have I helped you; and I will preserve you, and give you for a covenant of the people, to raise up the land, to make them inherit the desolate heritage:

paite: Suangkul tangte kiang a, Pawt un, mial a omte kiang a, Hong kilang un, na chih theihna ding in. Lampite ah ane zel ding ua, tang sang mai pengpongte ah atatna mun uh a-om ding hi.
english: saying to those who are bound, ‘Come out!’; to those who are in darkness, ‘Show yourselves!’ “They shall feed in the ways, and on all bare heights shall be their pasture.

paite: Agilkial un adangtak kei ding ua; kholum a bawlgim in ni in leng ahai sam kei ding hi; amaute itpa in api ding a, tui nak nei kiang ah api ding hi.
english: They shall not hunger nor thirst; neither shall the heat nor sun strike them: for he who has mercy on them will lead them, even by springs of water he will guide them.

paite: "Huchi in ka tang tengteng lampi ding in ka bawl ding a, ka lamliante leng sansak in a-om ding uh.
english: I will make all my mountains a way, and my highways shall be exalted.

paite: En in, hiaite gamlapi a kipan in ahong pai ding ua; en in hiaite mallam a kipante, tumlam a kipante in ahong pai ding uh; Sinim gam a kipan in ahong non pai ding uhi.
english: Behold, these shall come from far; and behold, these from the north and from the west; and these from the land of Sinim.”

paite: Vante aw, nuamtak in la sa un; lei aw, nuamsa in om in; tangte aw, la sakhe guih un; TOUPA'N lah amite alungmuan ngal a, a mi haksa thuakte leng ahehpih ding hi.
english: Sing, heavens; and be joyful, earth; and break forth into singing, mountains: for Yahweh has comforted his people, and will have compassion on his afflicted.

paite: Himahleh Zion in, "Jehovah in ahon paisan a, TOUPA'N ahon mangngilhta," achi hi.
english: But Zion said, “Yahweh has forsaken me, and the Lord has forgotten me.”

paite: "Numei in atapa, agilgah ngei, hehpihlouhna ding in anau nawi ne lai amangngilh thei a hia! Thei e, huaite'n zaw amangngilh uh ahi thei, himahleh ke'n zaw ka hon mangngilh kei ding hi.
english: “Can a woman forget her nursing child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? Yes, these may forget, yet I will not forget you!

paite: En in, ka khutpek ah ka hon gelh a; na kulhbaangte ka ma ah a-om gige hi.
english: Behold, I have engraved you on the palms of my hands; your walls are continually before me.

paite: Na tate akin ua, hon hihmang mite leh hon hihse mite'n ahon pawtsan ding uh.
english: Your children make haste; your destroyers and those who made you waste shall go forth from you.

paite: Dak inla, en vialvial inla, en in; hiai tengteng akikhawm ua, na kiang ah ahong pai uhi. Kei ka hin bang in, nang pahtawina kisilh bang in hiaite na kisilh a, mou akigak bang in hiaite in na kigak ngei ding," TOUPA'N achi.
english: Lift up your eyes all around, and see: all these gather themselves together, and come to you. As I live,” says Yahweh, “you shall surely clothe yourself with them all as with an ornament, and dress yourself with them, like a bride.

paite: "Na mun sia leh nutsiatsate leh na gam hihmansa thu zaw tu in a-omte a ding in na neu lota ngeingei ding a, nang hon valhte gamlapi ah a-omta ding uh.
english: “For, as for your waste and your desolate places, and your land that has been destroyed, surely now you shall be too small for the inhabitants, and those who swallowed you up shall be far away.

paite: Na ta mansak nung a na ta neih nawnte'n, 'Kei a ding in mun aneu lua a; ka omna ding in mun hon pia in,' chi in na bil ah ahon gen ding uh.
english: The children of your bereavement shall yet say in your ears, The place is too small for me; give place to me that I may dwell.

paite: Huchi in nang na lungsim in: 'Hiaite kua'n hon suaksak ua eita? Ka tate ka mangsak a, keimah kia sal a vialvak ka hi a; huchi in hiaite kua'n akem ua eita? Ngai in, keimah kia a nutsiat in ka om ngal a, hiaite koi a na om uh ahia? na chi ding, " chi in.
english: Then you will say in your heart, ‘Who has conceived these for me, since I have been bereaved of my children, and am solitary, an exile, and wandering back and forth? Who has brought up these? Behold, I was left alone; these, where were they?’”

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi, "Ngai in, namte a ding a khut zak in, michih a ding in ka chiamtehna ka takkhe ding; huchi in na tapate angpom in na kiang ah ahon pi ding ua, na tanute leng liangkolou a suan a pi in a-om ding uh.
english: Thus says the Lord Yahweh, “Behold, I will lift up my hand to the nations, and set up my banner to the peoples; and they shall bring your sons in their bosom, and your daughters shall be carried on their shoulders.

paite: Kumpipate na tate donpate ahi ding ua, kumpinute na tate donnute ahi ding uh; amau amai ua lei si in ahon be ding ua, na khe a leivui aliak ding uh; huchi in kei TOUPA ka hi chih na thei mai ding, hon ngak mite zahlak in a-om kei ding uh.
english: Kings shall be your nursing fathers, and their queens your nursing mothers: they shall bow down to you with their faces to the earth, and lick the dust of your feet; and you shall know that I am Yahweh; and those who wait for me shall not be disappointed.”

paite: "Gallakte mihattak a kipan suh a om in, sal lauhuaite hotkhiak in a-om ding uam?"
english: Shall the prey be taken from the mighty, or the lawful captives be delivered?

paite: Om na ke, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Mihattak salte suh in a-om ding ua, milauhuai gallakte hotkhiak in a-om ding; nang hon doute dou ding ka hi ngal a, na tate leng ka hondam ding hi.
english: But thus says Yahweh, “Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, and the prey of the terrible shall be delivered; for I will contend with him who contends with you, and I will save your children.

paite: Nang hon simmohte amau sa ka nesak ding; uain khum kham bang in amau sisan akham ding uh; huchi in mi tengteng in, kei TOUPA nangmah Hondampa leh nangmah Tanpa, Jakob Mihat ka hi chih, athei ding uh," chi in.
english: I will feed those who oppress you with their own flesh; and they shall be drunken with their own blood, as with sweet wine: and all flesh shall know that I, Yahweh, am your Savior, and your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.”
